none: PAS FindID 972256: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), probably Constantine I (306-337), Trier mint Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16, possibly RIC vol. 7 no. 341; if so, issue of 322. Obverse description: Helmeted bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription; CONSTAN TINVS AVG. Reverse description: Globe in altar inscribed VO/TIS/XX, three stars above. Reverse…
